description:
Start free API key authorization; no existing API key needed.

    Returns a verification_url. Ask the user to open that URL in their
    browser, enter their own email, then open the verification email and
    confirm access for their agent. This tool
    does not accept email addresses and does not send email.
    Do not choose, invent, or submit an email on the user's behalf.
    Poll check_api_key_status with the returned request_id at the supplied
    interval. Stop if the request expires. Never create new requests in a loop.
name: request_api_key
